# Skills

<!-- Generated by `nix build .#agent-skills-catalogue`; checks.agent-policy fails when this file differs. -->

Every skill installed for Lisa's agents on Vega, with the clients that load
it and the first sentence of its description. [Coding agents](agents.md)
explains where each set comes from. pstack skills run only when named.
